correctness.rationale: The complete corrected result is repairs/5/RESULT.md. It retains the all-start sharp bound and marks the already covered aligned calculations as background. For the binary alphabet, one symbol can be selected from each greedy arch; taking instead the closing symbols of all arches and then a bit absent from the rest produces a missing subsequence. The odd-part rule gives the four block shapes. Pending zero and empty input give the same state after the initial zero in a complete block; this supplies the third incoming state. Telescoping then leaves 3K minus the final bit plus the incoming pending-one flag, and the final state is determined solely by the last bit. Thus replacing any K≥1 complete middle blocks by one with the same last bit leaves 8ι−3N invariant. Every nonempty window either lies within one block, touches two consecutive blocks, or has such a middle. The independent run-boundary reconstruction, replayable with python3 /workspace/audit-evidence/paperfolding.py, checked all 12 block transfers and the 144, 1024 and 2048 endpoint cases, respectively giving extrema (−10,6), (−11,7), (−11,7). The endpoint cases are an exact covering superset, not a finite-prefix test. The same script generated both literal factors from the odd-part definition, found all length-five subsequences, and found the missing length-six words 100110 and 000100, respectively. Both constants are attained. The frozen verifier and notes were inspected but the uploaded script was not executed.

evidence: The prior complete-block transfer holds from either empty or pending one. Starting an aligned factor empty gives 3K minus the last bit; for dyadic K the odd-part rule gives the aligned dyadic formula.
The known prefix error is in [−8,1]. Comparing prefix counts leaves a possible extra arch from the incoming state, so the immediate all-factor estimate from that range is only [−17,9].
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The repaired result credits the transfer and both consequences. Sharpness for all factors requires bounding the interactions of an initial partial suffix with a terminal prefix, including the incoming zero state, and exhibiting actual extremizers; the inspected prior comparisons do not already do that.

value.rationale: The surviving result answers a natural uniform-in-start quantitative question for a canonical infinite word. It identifies both optimal integer endpoints of the deviation and witnesses on actual factors, not merely a bounded prefix error or an estimate derived by subtracting prefix sizes. The aligned formulas are background, not offered as value added.
